Emma, I support 18 tons each this month and will keep my own catch to 18. John, Kate, and Jack, will each of you explicitly commit to 18 as well? Emma, can you confirm yours?

Compared with 10 each, that gives every one of us an extra $8,000 now—$40,000 more across the group. The tradeoff matters: catching 10 each leaves 50, which reaches 100 next month under either recovery outcome. Catching 18 each leaves 10, so next month’s stock is 100 with 75% probability and just 20 with 25% probability. We avoid immediate collapse if everyone sticks to 18, but we accept a real risk of much lower income next month.

If your concern is that lean month, I support Emma’s stock-dependent limits rather than repeating 18 regardless of stock. At 20 tons, her proposed 10-ton reserve would allow only 2 tons each. Future cooperation isn’t enforceable, and seeing catches afterward cannot undo an overcatch, so I’m asking for clear commitments—not assuming them. John, would you accept this tradeoff, or would a smaller whole-ton catch earn your support?
